# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 / r0.1 — requirement crosswalk

Derived navigation view of `src/common/requirements.tex`; it adds no independent science. The scientist-facing and engineering PDFs use the same six canonical modules. All numerical realization/conformance statuses remain unavailable or unassessed; these are document obligations.

| Requirement | Scientist-facing source | Engineering interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-001 | [Canonical scientific section `purpose`](src/common/assumptions.tex) | Keep program order, conditional composition and numerical method approval separate; retain numerical unavailability and a separate owner freeze decision. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-002 | [Canonical scientific section `types`](src/common/notation.tex) | Bind quantity, unit/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, axes, timing, grouping, validity, causes and generations; shape or labels never substitute. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-003 | [Canonical scientific section `types`](src/common/notation.tex) | Bind candidate, accepted and applied objects/spaces and every transformation; equality of domain, support, unit, normalization, sign, representation, response, uncertainty or parentage needs an exact method/state fact. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-004 | [Canonical scientific section `types`](src/common/notation.tex) | For removal and rejoin separately require exact quantity, unit/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, support, reference/gauge, null-space, calibration and response compatibility and declared affine/quotient arithmetic. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-005 | [Canonical scientific section `composition`](src/common/equations.tex) | Use the applied operand, typed maps, exact role order/bypass locations and counts; do not infer inverse, equal domains/support, upstream bypass or numerical defaults. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-006 | [Canonical scientific section `composition`](src/common/equations.tex) | Use the map-valued expansion only for exact fixed linear F; define D and its linear model response/covariance only when A, Pi and B are all exact fixed linear. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-007 | [Canonical scientific section `state`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Retain immutable measured-base ancestry and the exact method-defined iteration input with required domain conversions; returning to base differs from prior-result processing. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-008 | [Canonical scientific section `support`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Retain all eight support/influence roles, their exact queries and path/application identities; a numerical method cannot waive a missing role. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-009 | [Canonical scientific section `support`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Use only permitted residual-and-model, residual-only, model-only or unavailable occurrence classes; retain model/prior origin in unavailable modes with no measurement/exposure/recovery inference. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-010 | [Canonical scientific section `state`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Rule changes require distinct method identities; new realizations under unchanged rules have distinct state/iteration/application generations. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-011 | [Canonical scientific section `state`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Assign exactly one of seven categories per factored operation/state component at each conditioning scope, with owner, parents, dependencies, order, count, path and failure. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-012 | [Canonical scientific section `response-local`](src/common/equations.tex) | Bind all required RF-01 through RF-07 identities and statuses with exact query convention, domains, fixed/rerun facts, scope, comparability and unavailable/discontinuity behavior. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-013 | [Canonical scientific section `response-outer`](src/common/equations.tex) | RF-03 is local with prior state fixed; RF-04 fixes extent; RF-05 includes stop/resource/selector; RF-07 composes the parent-domain query using components; RF-06 reruns included upstream producers. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-014 | [Canonical scientific section `uncertainty`](src/common/equations.tex) | Use exact applied-model joint conditioning and all four covariance terms under complete linearity/finite-second-moment premises; transform candidate/accepted covariance and preserve cross dependence. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-015 | [Canonical scientific section `uncertainty`](src/common/equations.tex) | Separate nine uncertainty roles, omitted variation and reference/gauge/null-space consequences; fixed gauge is not measured zero uncertainty; repeated iterations are not independent measurements. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-016 | [Canonical scientific section `uncertainty`](src/common/equations.tex) | Require exact fixed-state application parity; identify dependent successor generations; separate fixed-state/relearned method and ensemble rules without pooling, retaining member-specific states. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-017 | [Canonical scientific section `continuation`](src/common/definitions.tex) | After absolute zero-based index N continue at N+1 from sufficient S_(N+1), with the same future controls/profile; preserve all causal queries, reconstruction and failure contracts. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-018 | [Canonical scientific section `continuation`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Keep seed, continuation, restart, relearned successor, branch, retry, completion, selection and publication distinct; restart creates a new lineage. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-019 | [Canonical scientific section `continuation`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Separate completion/resource/convergence/policy-stop/failure/selection/fitness; bind convergence proposition, metric, scale, tolerance, direction, persistence, causes and generation without selecting values. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-020 | [Canonical scientific section `continuation`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Require all nine terminal fields, including full candidate population and response/uncertainty; missing hard selection dependencies block the claim; never mutate/relabel/replace the selected bundle. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-021 | [Canonical scientific section `completion`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Preserve every universal bundle role and hard result/continuation/response/uncertainty/selection dependency; narrower unavailable claims require both core and exact method permission. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-022 | [Canonical scientific section `completion`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Retain producer science and downstream admission; one complete grouping is method identity; no coadd commutation, generic new parent class or SCI-VAL execution of recurrence/selection is implied. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-023 | [Canonical scientific section `purpose`](src/common/assumptions.tex) | Require every scientific method-record field, its exact method-specific identity/owner decision and upstream numerical authority before any numerical route/result; a completed template is not approval. |
| SCI-FRUIT-REQ-024 | [Canonical scientific section `completion`](src/common/definitions.tex) | Preserve SCI-FRUIT-PRED-001 through 020 with explicit premises and unavailable claims; document verification establishes no numerical qualification or downstream fitness. |
